title: SignalTerrain
eyebrow: Waypoint Studio · Understand the world's signals
lead: SignalTerrain helps people observe and understand invisible environments — radio spectrum and educational cyber awareness — with evidence, context, and calm summaries. Not a news feed, not a SIEM, not offensive security.
mission: People who want to understand what changed in the radio environment or the public cyber landscape, why it matters, who may be affected, and what defensive next steps are worth considering — without hype, fear, or attack tooling.
problems: Radio and RF conditions are hard to follow without literacy and private logging tools
Public cyber news is noisy; people need topics, history, and defensive guidance — not exploit kits
Infrastructure and research signals lack a calm place to connect evidence over time

capabilityGroups.title: Radio & Spectrum Intelligence
capabilityGroups.description: Observe and learn the RF environment with private tools and educational framing.

capabilityGroups.title: Cyber Awareness
capabilityGroups.description: Educational defensive awareness only — topics, advisories, and guidance. Not scanning, penetration testing, offense, SOC, IDS, or IPS.
items: Major attacks and outages when sources exist
Changing threat priorities with confidence labels

capabilityGroups.title: Infrastructure & Research
capabilityGroups.description: Routing, cloud, communications, GPS disruptions, papers, standards, and Waypoint knowledge linked into the topic graph when cited sources exist.

principles: Four questions: what changed, why it matters, who is affected, what should happen next
Evidence, context, and historical perspective over fear or hype
Everything important becomes a topic that evolves
The living knowledge graph accumulates connections over time
Events normalize into Unified Intelligence Objects
Educational cyber awareness only — not scanning, offense, SOC, IDS, or IPS
Audio, receivers, and precise locations stay local first
Never fabricate signals, incidents, or threat claims

modules.title: Cyber Awareness Intelligence Engine

modules.title: Receiver management

modules.title: Incident timeline

privacyPhilosophy: Receivers, audio, notes, and precise locations stay on your device first. Samples are labeled samples — never presented as live intelligence. Nothing syncs until a path earns trust.
futureDirection: Deeper RF observation tools, richer defensive cyber topic coverage, infrastructure awareness when sources exist, and carefully bounded future phases that remain educational — never offensive.
